caption: The drawing depicts a bronze or brass-colored, dog-shaped object standing on a rectangular base. The dog is rendered in a somewhat simplified, stylized manner, with its body angled in profile facing right and its left legs more visible. The dog’s mouth is open, showing visible teeth, and its ears are flopped downward. A long, thick, curved tail extends upwards then loops back down behind the body, resting just above the base. The rectangular base is also bronze or brass-colored, with some texture and shading that adds dimension. In a box in the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, simple line-drawing diagram of the same object, indicating two measurements: "11 3/8" for the length and "6 1/4" for the height. The entire composition is centered on a cream or off-white background, with the main image and the inset diagram each enclosed by faint orange or brown lines. At the lower right, the text "V. P. Rosel . Saltz. Del. 254" is written.
title: Brass Dog Nutcracker
